Q: SQL select distinct returns duplicates - no join, one column A:

The issues is most probably due to the trim creating duplicates when used with the cross supply , I would run the insert into a new table with no indexes , then select from that table with a group by to see if you have any duplicates .

Q: Prolog: Simple rule to get difference between numbers fails and does not retry A:

I have figured out that when I simply have the conditional Start + Length = Finish, that doesn't try to search for a value of Length to satisfy the equation, but rather blindly tries to add an instantiated variable to an uninstantiated one, which obviously fails. instead, I should have used plus(Start,Length,Finish) to get a satisfactory value for Length.
